stories.headline: Prabowo's May Day rally at Monas draws massive crowds, marks announcement of multiple pro-labor policies
stories.summary: President Prabowo Subianto attended the May Day 2026 celebration at the National Monument (Monas) in Jakarta on May 1, drawing hundreds of thousands of workers. His appearance — which included dancing, shirt-tossing, and riding a Pindad vehicle — went viral, while his speech announced multiple policies including an ILO fishing worker convention ratification (Perpres No. 25/2026), formation of a PHK (layoff) mitigation task force, fertilizer price cuts of 20%, affordable housing installment plans of up to 40 years, new worker cities plans, and pledges to continue the MBG free meals program.

stories.headline: Military court opens trial of four TNI soldiers charged with acid attack on KontraS activist
stories.summary: A military court in Jakarta began trial proceedings on April 29 for four TNI intelligence officers (BAIS) charged with carrying out an acid attack on KontraS activist and deputy coordinator Andrie Yunus, who had campaigned against military expansion into civilian roles. Prosecutors sought up to 12 years imprisonment; civil society groups questioned whether all perpetrators were charged and disputed the 'personal grudge' motive stated in the indictment.

stories.headline: Fatal train collision near Jakarta kills 15, injures dozens
stories.summary: A commuter train and a long-distance express train collided at Bekasi station on the outskirts of Jakarta on April 27, with the death toll rising to 15 over subsequent days with 88 injured. Rescue teams worked for two days to extract passengers trapped in the wreckage; Indonesia's state railway (KAI) CEO confirmed the final toll on April 28.

stories.headline: eFishery founder Gibran Huzaifah sentenced to 9 years for fraud in Indonesia's largest startup collapse
stories.summary: A Bandung district court sentenced eFishery co-founder and former CEO Gibran Huzaifah to nine years imprisonment on April 29 for embezzlement and money laundering, concluding an eight-month case stemming from a $300 million financial scandal at the once-$1.4 billion-valued agritech startup. Huzaifah had previously admitted to falsifying financial statements.

stories.headline: Pertamina holds fuel prices as private stations raise diesel sharply; fuel queues form in Riau
stories.summary: Private fuel retailers Vivo and BP AKR raised non-subsidized diesel prices sharply to around Rp30,890/liter in early May 2026, driven by global oil price pressures, while state-owned Pertamina held its prices stable. Long queues formed at fuel stations in Pekanbaru, Riau during the long holiday weekend; Pertamina increased supply by 20% in the region and raised some non-subsidized grades on May 4.

stories.headline: Bank Indonesia expands cross-border QRIS payment system to China as rupiah hits historic low

Separately, the rupiah hit a historic low of Rp17,346/USD on April 30, prompting BI Governor Perry Warjiyo to hold investor briefings in Singapore on April 28 to reassure markets of Indonesia's economic resilience.

stories.headline: Indonesia implements child social media ban; Roblox announces facial scan age verification compliance
stories.summary: Roblox announced on April 30 that it was implementing facial scan age verification for Indonesian users under 16 to comply with the government's new social media regulations for minors, which took effect in late March 2026. The Communications Ministry urged all platforms to report the number of suspended underage accounts, citing Indonesia's 45 million Roblox users, 23 million of whom are under 16.

Appointments included Muhammad Jumhur Hidayat as Environment Minister and M. Qodari as head of the new communications body (Bakom), replacing Angga Raka Prabowo.

stories.summary: Italy's parliament approved on April 28 the government's plan to donate an ageing aircraft carrier to Indonesia, with officials saying it would strengthen bilateral ties while avoiding costly dismantling. Indonesian defense officials said accepting the donation would be more cost-efficient than buying a new vessel and could support disaster relief operations.
